blockDom: div.<name>.block[data-block-name] inside div.<name>-wrapper; the section gains .<name>-container
buttonLook: a.button = the source .btn.btn-md (pill, 2px border, 1rem 1.75rem, text-lg/600) + trailing arrow (::after mask /icons/arrow.svg); primary = gold, secondary = outline in --color-secondary
sectionMetadata: server-side (rendering version >= 2): style values become section classes; foundation styles .light / .dark
icons: authored :name: tokens become span.icon.icon-<name> (name = letters/hyphens, digits only trailing — ':nav-3d-design:' is NOT converted); chrome blocks inline /icons/<name>.svg via scripts/chrome-utils.js (currentColor)
containers: the source sizes against named containers: main (page) and section (band). main is `container: main / inline-size`, every main > .section is `container: section / inline-size`; header/footer blocks carry both names. Block CSS lifted from canon keeps its @container main / section queries
theme: page default is the source's dark scope (html[data-theme=dark]); [data-theme=light|dark] and main .section.light|.dark switch the --color-base-* palette
fonts: styles/fonts.css: Montserrat + Source Sans 3 (OFL) woff2, latin + latin-ext + italic; metric-matched montserrat-fallback / source-sans-3-fallback in styles.css

chrome.header: blocks/header ← /nav (utility bar, brand + CTA, mega menus, Customers dropdown, strips); breadcrumb derived from the URL path
chrome.footer: blocks/footer ← /footer (brand, link columns, legal, accessibility band, floating Ask button)
chrome.sharedHelpers: scripts/chrome-utils.js (h, loadIcons, icon, authoredIcon, stripInstrumentation, plainLink)

lint: eslint (airbnb-base) on blocks/ scripts/ (stardust/ ignored as evidence); stylelint standard on blocks/**/*.css styles/*.css — classes kebab-case (BEM __/-- renamed to -)
